title: Music tech patent portfolio evaluation
summary: Stilta builds agentic AI to enforce, defend, and analyze patents. Backed by a16z, NVIDIA and Y Combinator, Stilta is used by leading IP firms and in-house IP teams at global enterprises
body_markdown: Compared to traditional methods, Stilta's AI-driven approach offered a different path: agents that autonomously, at-scale, search for infringement evidence across public sources and map it directly to patent claim elements. Qualitative, fast, and built to surface what manual processes miss. The analysis equips the organization with evidence-backed material to position the patent portfolio's commercial relevance and market value ahead of a potential trade and securitization.
